title: HCGW19 5-round AES / aes-5r-integral-cp-hcgw2019

target.description: Five nonlinear AES rounds with whitening, omitted final MixColumns and included final AddRoundKey. Key-dependent subspaces are covered by exhaustive bin/indicator testing, not selected weak master keys.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key and its expanded round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: Fix P[0,0],P[1,1],P[2,2],P[3,3] and vary the remaining twelve bytes over 2^96 plaintexts. Count every value of C[0,0] XOR C[1,3].
assumptions: The AES-bin existence property is deterministic; random-permutation error estimates use the source statistical approximations. No prior key-byte knowledge or related-key oracle.
setting.reference_model: Distinguish five-round AES under one unknown secret key from a random permutation with the same chosen-plaintext or chosen-ciphertext access; test all key-dependent bins without prior key knowledge.

time.note: Algorithm 1 histogram work; oracle acquisition is reported separately.

memory.note: 256 counters, each must represent counts as large as 2^88; source 8-bit vector wording is not a valid byte-size budget.

preprocessing.note: No numerical resource amount supplied for this endpoint.

success.description: Source type-II error approximately 2^-40.7 under its normal/binomial approximation; AES acceptance is one. This value is false-positive probability, not attack success. The local-normal arithmetic is disputed; the author error value is not independently certified and is not replaced with a reviewer approximation.

field_conflicts.label: Counter width
field_conflicts.description: The source describes an 8-bit counter vector but compares an entry with 2^88; retain a counter count, not fabricated bytes.

observations.locator: PDF p.10 Proposition 5 and Algorithm 1 Step 6.

field_conflicts.label: Proposition5 local-normal error arithmetic
field_conflicts.description: The stated Bin(2^96,2^-8) variance yields fixed-bin local-normal mass approximately2^-45.322925, versus source2^-48.64. A256-bin union/local-normal scale is approximately2^-37.322925 versus2^-40.7. Bucket dependence and permutation sampling prevent promoting this arithmetic check to a certified replacement error theorem.
